China's Spy Chief Highlights AI National Security Concerns

China's Minister of State Security, Chen Wenqing, has warned of national security risks posed by artificial intelligence. He stated that AI could be exploited by hostile foreign forces to destabilize the country. Chen emphasized the need for robust measures to prevent AI from being used for espionage and sabotage. The remarks were made during a period when global powers, including the US, are also discussing guardrails for AI development due to its potential risks.
